dev.reason: The API module and local entrypoints consume the Workspace file-backed contract; first-party OIDC/private-admin integration and cross-repository runtime checks remain candidate-only.

demo.reason: First-party OIDC integration, prepared users, persistent curated data, and immutable image release are not verified.

preprod.reason: Provider-neutral OIDC and private-admin integration, file-backed database/auth configuration, source-bound immutable images, and external deployment evidence remain incomplete.

prod.reason: Production OIDC/MFA, identity and data migration, immutable release artifacts, infrastructure/recovery ownership, rollback evidence, and deployment approval are not established.
